paragraphs.text: The Corian Escarpment is a long, steep, and tall ridge running through central Otaria , on the plane of Dominaria .

Also called the "Wall of the World", the Corian Escarpment ran through the former desert and the Stubble Fields of central Otaria , separating high and low ground. While Aphetto and the Grand Coliseum and its surrounding swamps lay on the upper flats, Krosa lay below the ridge.

The Corian Escarpment effectively separated the realms of Phage and Kamahl , as well as bordering on the realm of Ixidor . In addition, the ancient city of Sanctum was built into a hidden and partially collapsed part of the ridge, undiscovered for millennia until Stonebrow and Zagorka , fleeing from the Nightmare War , discovered it.
